ai_limits.attach_files_desc: Files attached to one message stay readable for the model
ai_limits.attach_total_desc: Attachments are held in memory for the chat
ai_limits.copies_desc: One copy or array step cannot flood the model with copies
ai_limits.terrain_points_desc: The terrain surface is meshed in one step
ai_limits.preview_elements_desc: The preview is drawn every frame; the rest are listed on the card
ai_limits.critic_cycles_desc: Each review cycle costs one more model step
ai_limits.variants_desc: Each variant is a full generator run
ai_limits.http_read_timeout_desc: A stalled cloud model frees the chat after this time
ai_limits.http_read_timeout_local_desc: A local model may think long before it answers
ai_limits.mcp_read_timeout_desc: A stalled tool server frees the chat after this time
